name: Sustainable Catalyst Workspace v1.14.0 — Public Research Packages & Portable Knowledge Objects
release_name: Public Research Packages & Portable Knowledge Objects
features: hardens the public beta around real-world browser, storage, recovery, and deployment conditions before adding another major subsystem
adds local Field Diagnostics for browser capabilities, workspace size, storage probe latency, serialization/parse latency, DOM density, recovery snapshot state, and deployment profile
adds explicit advisory thresholds for attention signals without a health score or automated judgment
adds user-generated issue report export with observed behavior, expected behavior, reproduction steps, issue type, and impact
adds a portable text support summary for low-friction troubleshooting
keeps diagnostic exports privacy-minimized: no project content, object text, source URLs, device identifier, query string, or hash is added automatically
adds no automatic issue submission, telemetry, or hidden repair channel
keeps storage schema 27 and project schema 12.0 unchanged; no data migration is required
retains the v0.30 Start experience, guest-first access, explicit account backup/sync, and human-controlled lifecycle governance
Notebook Collections & Knowledge Linking
grounded notebook questions
citation-required answer review
portable assistance request/response
explicit draft materialization
adds notebook-level Change Review from explicit notebook snapshots without a hidden score
adds selective notebook reconciliation that creates a new notebook copy and preserves both source states
adds a derived notebook audit history from authoritative notebook records rather than a shadow ledger
adds source-lineage inspection across capture provenance, explicit links, promotions, synthesis, assistance, restore points, and sync state

Collaboration Architecture Foundation: explicit local actors, ownership policies, role grants, canonical-target comments, review proposals, and shareable-project contracts without server permission simulation.

Institutional Research Packages: explicit frozen disclosure bundles for selected research, recorded provenance, citations, task context, and collaboration review context without source-project mutation or automatic publication.
adds a Product Journey route that exposes the complete Discover → Capture → Organize → Analyze → Synthesize → Decide → Compose → Review → Export/Handoff flow as one coherent public beta experience
adds a local topology check for the nine product stages without hidden readiness scoring, behavioral telemetry, automatic completion, or canonical mutation
adds session-only manual walkthrough marks and a privacy-minimized product-journey report for field validation
adds contextual research workflow guidance derived from visible local project state without hidden scoring or inferred completion
refines empty states so blank Research, Notebook, Knowledge, Tasks, Citations, and Composition surfaces explain the next explicit action
keeps guidance advisory only: no automatic task creation, AI invocation, lifecycle advancement, navigation, or canonical research mutation
adds a dedicated Start → Help & Recovery surface with searchable product guidance and explicit local-first operating boundaries
adds recovery playbooks for save verification failures, restore-as-copy, rejected imports, sync conflicts, device migration, shared review, and institutional handoff
keeps product help advisory and privacy-minimized: no automatic repair, restore, upload, sync, telemetry, or canonical mutation
summary: Public Product Beta III validates Workspace as one coherent nine-stage journey from discovery through deliberate export or handoff, using local topology checks and session-only human walkthrough marks without hidden scoring, behavioral telemetry, or canonical mutation.

visual_patch.name: Editorial Header Rule Balance
visual_patch.basis: Matches recurring 4px Sustainable Catalyst hero/header top rules; card rules remain typically 3px.

cross_browser_device_compatibility.client_export_fallback: Blob/object URL -> bounded data URI for small payloads

journey.label: Discover
journey.intent: Find relevant public knowledge or orient the inquiry before capture.

journey.label: Capture
journey.intent: Capture sources, excerpts, notes, questions, and initial research material.

journey.label: Organize
journey.intent: Group, retrieve, and connect canonical research without duplicating source records.

journey.label: Analyze
journey.intent: Record datasets, assumptions, methods, comparisons, and findings.

journey.label: Synthesize
journey.intent: Combine selected research into traceable synthesis while retaining source anchors.

journey.label: Decide
journey.intent: Compare alternatives, uncertainty, risk, criteria, and rationale.

journey.label: Compose
journey.intent: Build a document or briefing from selected research and citations.

journey.label: Review
journey.intent: Inspect provenance, activity, recovery, compatibility, accessibility, performance, and review context.

journey.label: Export / Handoff
journey.intent: Move a deliberate portable copy or minimized context into the appropriate next environment.

accessibility_performance_final_audit.target: WCAG 2.2 AA plus bounded field-performance budgets
